subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 upstream GitHub Action updates in workflows that use app, registry, scanning, repository, and model credentials?
rationale: The substitutions are mechanically sound, but CI cannot decide whether the new third-party action implementations are acceptable within OpenClaw's privileged workflow trust boundary.

options.title: Accept After Exact-Head Checks
options.body: Approve the reviewed immutable pins and merge once the refreshed head completes every required check successfully.

options.title: Split Privileged Updates
options.body: Separate token, registry, CodeQL, and Codex updates from low-privilege setup actions for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Hold The Batch
options.body: Keep the existing pins until maintainers are comfortable accepting the upstream implementation changes.

recommendation.title: Accept After Exact-Head Checks
recommendation.body: Approve the reviewed immutable pins and merge once the refreshed head completes every required check successfully.
